diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted trace rises to ~0.5 by 5 h and then remains flat (~0.46–0.49) through 18 h, which could reflect either stationary phase or reader saturation. Dilution checks argue against saturation: at 18 h, 10x-diluted aliquots read 0.0491 and 0.0472 (mean 0.0481), which rescale to 0.481, essentially the undiluted 18 h reading of 0.4885. At 16 h, 10x-diluted reads were 0.0485 and 0.0479 (mean 0.0482), rescaling to 0.482 versus the undiluted 16 h reading of 0.4727. Thus the reader responds proportionally across the relevant range and the late-culture OD is consistently ~0.48, not clipped. The 100x reads were near the blank/noise floor and inconsistent, so they were not used for estimation.
